recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13536 unless Pharmacy opens a new current-version request for medication brand/name modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-13536 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. The original description asked for a Medication brand CodeableConcept plus an isBrand constraint, but the final Pharmacy WG comments and vote narrowed the change to restoring the DSTU2 Medication.code comment that other codings may only be literal translations or lower-granularity codes.
initial_application: Git commit 333047669dbe6165ff81da07eabda57b3f9880e6 explicitly mentions TR#13536 and appended the approved lower-granularity sentence to the then-authoritative Medication spreadsheet sources; later source refactors carried that text into source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Pharmacy. The current Medication StructureDefinition has the approved comment on Medication.code and has no active Medication.brand or Medication.isBrand element outside archived historical examples. Later FHIR-19363 resolved no change for separate Medication short/brand names, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Adding a brand element now would exceed the final modified resolution and depend on the retired isBrand model, while the approved text is already present in the authoritative source.

related_jiras.note: Later Pharmacy no-change decision about Medication short and brand names supports not adding a separate core brand-name element for this seed.
